description: This file is a Yocto build include file (.inc) for OpenVSwitch, defining dependencies, source URIs, configuration options, package contents, systemd services, init scripts, and post-installation scripts for building and installing OpenVSwitch within a Yocto-based Linux distribution.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepend step to modify CC variable for compilation, replacing '-Wa,' with '-Xassembler'.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Prepend step to generate systemd service file using a Python script, based on the package configuration.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Append step to install configuration files, init scripts, systemd units, and Python packages into the target filesystem, and run make modules_install.

methods.name: pkg_postinst_ontarget:${PN}-pki
methods.description: Post-install step to initialize PKI directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: pkg_postinst_ontarget:${PN}-testcontroller
methods.description: Post-install step to initialize PKI and set up certificates for the test controller.
